Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Dr. Ross Turchaninov, a leading expert in the field of medical massage! I'm the founder and director of the Science of Massage Institute, which provides continuing education courses and certification programs for massage therapists.

On this channel, you'll find a wealth of information and resources related to medical massage, including instructional videos, interviews, and highlights from Dr. Ross's live training events.

As a subscriber to this channel, you'll have exclusive access to Dr. Ross's vast knowledge and expertise in the field of medical massage. You'll learn about the latest techniques, research, and trends in the industry, and gain valuable insights that can help you improve your practice and better serve your clients.

So, if you're ready to take your massage practice to the next level and stay up-to-date on the latest developments in the field, be sure to subscribe to this channel today. You won't want to miss a single video!
